rationale: If microexperience can exist without organism-level experience, it does not ground it.

sources.quote: The kind of microexperience that looked to be most helpful in explaining my o-experience in this way looks to be eminently compatible with the absence of my o-experience.

Panpsychist zombies seem to be coherent, and this seems to imply that the postulation of microsubjects (conscious subjects at the micro-level) sheds no explanatory light on the existence of macrosubjects
